moral: Where there is a will, there is a way.

story: Once upon a time, there was a thirsty crow. On a hot day, he flew everywhere looking for water, but he could not find any. At last, he saw a pitcher with a little water at the bottom. The crow tried to drink, but his beak could not reach the water. He thought for a while. Then he got an idea. He picked up small stones one by one and dropped them into the pitcher. Slowly, the water level rose. Soon, the water came up to the top. The crow drank the water happily and flew away.
